plan.environment: the morning dining hall: one long wooden table covered with children's family drawings, brown chairs, morning light from the left windows, a tiled counter on the right
plan.emotional_guidance: Valence: warm, resolved, tender. Arousal: calm, settling.
plan.visual_style: finished full-colour 3D animation, identical in look, lighting and character design to the first frame; never a sketch

audio.sounds: P01 the morning hall's gentle air, crayons at the long table; P02 a soft airy whoosh as the lettering rises into view; P03 a gentle metallic shimmer as it settles
audio.room: the morning hall, bright and calm

panels.video_beat: hold on the final wide of the morning dining hall: Maria and MACA holding hands beside the long table of drawings, Chico at MACA's knee, the children drawing

a slow rack focus: the camera stays still while the focus pulls away from the family, the whole scene softening into a warm blur and dimming slightly, and the message lettering rises gently into view in front of it as solid brushed sheet metal and settles, catching a warm edge light
hold on the message with gentle micro-movement: a soft warm flicker, a cool blue rim glow and dust motes drifting in the morning light

plan.continuity: the camera does not move: Maria, MACA and Chico stay exactly where they are in the first frame, holding hands, only going out of focus; once the message appears, the lettering keeps the exact spelling, letter shapes, line breaks and layout of the first and last frames for the whole clip
preventions: never add, remove, reorder or reshape any letter
no extra words, captions or logos
one Maria, one MACA, one Chico

design: series title rig: reveal between two pinned frames (ulac/titlerig.py)
